title: Measurement-aware identification of 48-hour acute kidney injury persistence
description: Reproducible phenotype specification, database mappings, statistical scripts, synthetic tests, and non-disclosive aggregate results for interval-defined 48-hour persistence of creatinine-defined acute kidney injury across MIMIC-IV v3.1, SICdb v1.0.8, and eICU-CRD v2.0. Version 1.2.0 separates index-AKI search from recovery follow-up, re-anchors the SICdb coverage endpoint to first ICU bed assignment, anchors controlled thinning to the original index episode, and adds stage, one-episode-per-patient, feasibility, late-onset and recurrent-AKI checks.
